run_acute_eval_unit: run the AcuteEvalRunner unit to wait for an agent to submit conversation comparison evaluations
get_new_task_data: get new task data for a worker including onboarding and comparison tasks from the task queue
load_conversation_data: load conversation pairings from a JSON lines file and split into onboarding and desired tasks
check_worker_approval: check and update worker approval status based on onboarding task correctness threshold
cleanup_incomplete_unit: cleanup an incomplete unit by requeuing its task data back into the task queue
